symptom: ako/mxcli#1560 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1628): a button passing a widget's SELECTION to a microflow — a Data grid 2 control-bar button passing its grid, a data view footer button passing a combo box's selection, a control-bar data view whose microflow source takes the grid — described as `Action: call microflow M.ACT_Remove` with the argument gone; describe → check reported CE1571 13 times on TestApp pages mx check passes, and rebuilding the nine pages from their description gave 13 real CE1571 on mx check 11.14.0. An in-place describe → exec kept the grid ones only because the stored Data grid 2 passed through unchanged; the combo box buttons (native, rebuilt) lost theirs: 2 CE1571
cause: Studio Pro stores a selection argument as a Forms$PageVariable naming only the widget (Widget: grid2, every other slot empty). pageVariableArgValue read PageParameter/SnippetParameter/LocalVariable and deliberately not Widget, because the builder had no way to write `$grid` back: classifyFlowArgValue knew parameters and page variables only, so `$grid2` fell to Expression "$grid2", and bindParameterMappingValue had no widget kind (a widget kind fell to the PageParameter slot). Show page had solved the same shape for the control bar alone (#122); the flow-call path was its untouched twin
file: mdl/executor/cmd_pages_flow_args.go (flowArgVariableValue, classifyFlowArgValue widget kind, widgetNameSet), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_output.go (extractMicroflowParameters, extractNanoflowParameters, extractPageParameters), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_datasource.go (flowSourceArgs), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder.go (isDocumentWidget), mdl/executor/cmd_pages_create_v3.go, cmd_pages_layout_v3.go, cmd_alter_page.go (alterDocumentWidgets), mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go (bindParameterMappingValue)
fix: Describe renders a Widget-only PageVariable on a flow call or flow data source as `$widget` (snippet calls unchanged: no Studio Pro mapping has one). The builder binds `$name` as kind "widget" when name is a widget of the document — every name in a CREATE PAGE/SNIPPET/LAYOUT, the stored tree plus the added widgets in an ALTER — after parameters and page variables, which win on a clash; the writer puts it in the Widget slot with Expression ""
insight: **Run describe → check over a whole Studio Pro-authored project before trusting a report's repro.** The reporter's repro (a data view with a button) passed check; the 16 TestApp hits were two different defects, and a BSON dump of each flagged widget's mappings sorted them in minutes (13 Widget-only variables, 3 empty mapping lists). **The in-place round trip hid the loss**: pluggable passthrough (#721 L4) kept the stored grid, so control-bar buttons survived exec — only `drop` + `create` from the description (or a different project) exercises the builder; do that before calling a describe gap harmless. **A comment saying 'deliberately not read' records a write-side gap, not a fact about Mendix** — fix both halves together or the reader is right to stay blind. A pre-fix script wrote Expression "$grid" and mxbuild 10.24.25 accepted it (0 errors), so mx check cannot distinguish the forms; Studio Pro's stored shape is the evidence. Left open: a database-source multi-select combo box rebuilt from describe comes back source 'context', selection Single (CE0642, and CE0115 against a list parameter) — a separate combo box round-trip loss
